name: Scream fUSD collateral priced through the USDC feed
summary: Scream configured the scFUSD market to read Chainlink's USDC/USD feed and then enabled it as 85% collateral. The oracle therefore kept valuing fUSD near one dollar after fUSD traded below par. Campaign accounts supplied discounted fUSD and borrowed liquid USDC, WFTM, WETH and WBTC against the false value; the anchor account supplied 461,109.4376 fUSD and borrowed 390,000 USDC 59 blocks later.
notes: Scream had assigned scFUSD to the USDC/USD aggregator 140 seconds earlier. This transaction then changed scFUSD's collateral factor from zero to 0.85, making that aliased price borrow-bearing. The factor and feed assignment both persisted through the anchor, and no later pre-anchor AggregatorUpdated event selected another scFUSD feed.

Conservative onchain lower bound from three accounts that each supplied at least 461,109 fUSD during the campaign. For each account and borrowed market, every Borrow amount after its first large fUSD supply was summed and every later RepayBorrow amount, including liquidation repayments and accrued interest, was subtracted through Fantom block 123055284. Positive residual principal is 24,480.522463 USDC, 2,875,037.153995981309124780 WFTM and 516.974432907347463696 WETH; the WBTC leg was fully repaid and is excluded. Subtracting interest-bearing repayments makes this lower than the unrecovered principal. It also excludes every other affected account. USDC is valued at par; Chainlink FTM/USD and ETH/USD returned $0.36282771 and $2,009.08543527 immediately before the anchor.
The loss is an exact onchain lower bound for three accounts, not the widely reported approximately $35 million platform-wide bad debt.
